title: Context7
description: Remote library documentation, with authentication delegated to the MCP client.

guidance.reason: This catalog selects documented client-managed OAuth to avoid embedding API keys; not a claim that the provider prefers OAuth.

notes: Requires an OAuth-capable Streamable HTTP client and account authorization. AgentSync does not perform login or verify entitlement.

optional_methods.notes: Provider also documents /mcp with an Authorization Bearer API key. Not selectable until secret-reference binding is implemented.
